description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel class, which serves as a data model in the OrangeHRM system's API for representing an employee's leave entitlement details, including employee information and entitlement calculations.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's leave entitlement details, including employee info and entitlement calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee object, a list of LeaveEntitlement objects, and an optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an associative array suitable for API responses, computing current and updated entitlement values.
